crossRefs.note: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.”
I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked…
All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
“An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
“He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we…
He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ ”
About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why…
The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”
lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
“Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
Don’t you know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of the…
Who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out…
Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music…

translations.web: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
